mapper.insert: insert into ums_member_identity_change (member_id, real_name, id_card, id_card_hash, old_id_card_hash, reason, status, pending_member_id, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{realName,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiCryptoTypeHandler}, #{idCard,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiCryptoTypeHandler}, #{idCard,typeHandler=com.chengyinhub.business.security.PiiBlindIndexTypeHandler}, #{oldIdCardHash}, #{reason}, 'PENDING', #{memberId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, member_id, real_name, id_card, id_card_hash, old_id_card_hash, reason, status, review_note, reviewer_user_id, review_time, create_time, update_time from ums_member_identity_change where id = #{id} for update
select id, member_id, status, review_note, review_time, create_time from ums_member_identity_change where member_id = #{memberId} order by create_time desc, id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update ums_member_identity_change set status = #{status}, pending_member_id = null, real_name = null, id_card = null, review_note = #{reviewNote}, reviewer_user_id = #{reviewerUserId}, review_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING' and member_id = #{memberId}
